Introducing the Brown Fox Selvedge, a 13oz Japanese selvedge denim made entirely from organic FoxFibre® cotton—grown in California by cotton breeder and environmental pioneer Sally Fox. This denim contains no dyes or bleach. The brown color comes directly from the cotton plant itself.
Sally Fox began her work in the 1980s, selectively breeding heirloom brown cotton varieties with white Pima to create long-staple, naturally pigmented cotton that could be commercially spun. Her work eliminated the need for chemical dyes, significantly reducing the environmental impact of textile production. The FoxFibre® used in this denim is grown using regenerative organic farming methods, making it one of the most sustainable cotton sources available.
The denim is woven in Okayama, Japan, and spun in Osaka, using undyed natural warp yarns and naturally brown weft yarns. The result is a warm, earthy-toned fabric with subtle surface variation and a soft hand. Over time, the fabric darkens and develops a rich patina with wear and washing.

p-ironheart-10533899796746.d:
The original US Army M-1943 is often considered to be the godfather of the modern military “Field Jacket” — setting a blueprint for all that followed and serving as a predecessor to the iconic M-65. Its design significantly improved upon the inadequate M-41 from a few years earlier, offering a wider array of pockets, fuller body coverage, and a roomier fit that could be layered with a wool liner for warmth during WWII and later the Korean War.
New for FW26, Iron Heart’s take on the M-43 honours its heritage while updating the design with a few typical over-engineered upgrades. Made from vintage-style 9.5oz back sateen fabric — pigment-dyed to allow for gradual, low-contrast fading over time — we’ve fitted the jacket with a Japanese Ventile lining for an added layer of water resistance, oversized four-hole buttons to ensure secure fastenings, and poly/cotton stitching throughout for strength. The result is a versatile, functional and highly durable outer layer that doesn’t compromise its authentic 1940s military styling.

p-ironheart-9551665398026.d:
Our traditional straight cut jeans, made from 16oz slubby selvedge denim. The most heavily textured denim in the Iron Heart lineup, our slubby selvedge is woven slowly and loosely (think off-the-scale loom-chatter!), resulting in a more irregular twill and an uneven fabric hand on both the face and reverse. Compared to other heavyweight weaves, this is a softer, more breathable denim which brims with distinctive character.
To create this darkened variation, we take a pair of standard IH-634S-SLB jeans and steep the entire garment in black dye using a direct dyeing process. This stains the indigo denim and stitching, with the added bonus of removing all shrinkage from the fabric. A unique middle ground between our traditional indigo and black denims, over time the fabric will gradually fade with blue-tinged hues in high-wear areas.
